channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Scientists find new defense against fungus threatening global food supply
item.description: Scientists have identified a potential new weapon against a destructive fungus that threatens rice, wheat, and barley worldwide, using engineered organisms.

item.title: Small cancer cells with extra chromosomes found more aggressive
item.description: Scientists have found that unusually small cancer cells with extra chromosomes can be more aggressive than larger ones, growing faster and spreading more.

item.title: Study Finds Sharp Divide in Alzheimer's Brain
item.description: A rare brain examination found that areas cleared of amyloid plaques had very little harmful tau buildup.

item.title: Arctic Sea Ice Reaches Another Low in 2026
item.description: Arctic sea ice is declining in both winter and summer, with satellite records showing the remaining ice is thinner and younger.
